name: Groove Quantum
description: Groove Quantum builds scalable quantum processors based on germanium spin qubits, using fabrication processes compatible with standard semiconductor manufacturing. The company was spun out of QuTech (TU Delft / TNO) and received a €10M EIC Accelerator grant and equity investment in 2025.

products.name: Germanium Spin Qubit Processor
products.description: Scalable quantum processor based on germanium spin qubits compatible with standard semiconductor manufacturing

news.title: Groove Quantum raises EUR 16M seed and unveils world's largest 18-qubit semiconductor spin-qubit processor
news.excerpt: Groove Quantum raised EUR 16M in combined seed funding co-led by Innovation Industries and 55 North, with EIC Fund and Verve Ventures participating. The company simultaneously demonstrated an 18-qubit germanium spin-qubit processor — the largest semiconductor spin-qubit system built to date — targeting CMOS-compatible industrial-scale quantum manufacturing.

news.title: Groove Quantum Secures €10 Million EIC Accelerator Funding
news.excerpt: Groove Quantum secured €10 million in EIC Accelerator funding to scale its germanium-based quantum chip technology. The Delft startup was one of 40 companies selected from over 1,000 applicants to receive a mix of grant and equity support.
